pages.title: Aurochs
pages.text: The aurochs ($(o)Bos primigenius$()) is an extinct species of wild cattle that once ranged across Europe, Asia and North Africa. The last known individual died in Poland in 1627.$(br2)The aurochs is the wild ancestor of domestic cattle, which were domesticated from it independently in the Near East and South Asia.$(br2)Bulls were much larger than most modern cattle, with long, forward-curving horns and a dark coat.
